projects.name: Book shop
projects.description: Gummy Books — a staff back office for a book shop, designed in the studio and rendered from JSON by the demo app.

config.text: This month at a glance. Everything below is one page load (summary) in skeleton mode: each block draws its own placeholder until the numbers land.

config.text: The 24 best-rated books as customers see them: a card per book from a repeater, the whole card a link, and a Featured line on the items whose own field says so.
The catalogue, paged and sorted by the API. Filter by genre, then by one of that genre’s authors. Edit opens the book form; only a manager sees Delete in it. Click a row for the book page.
